content: Post‑separation division concerned property, vehicles, and residual sums, with disputes over damages from a house fire and occupancy indemnity. The interpretive issues: timing of dissolution (pre‑2015 rule), residual community scope, and proof standards for damages and exclusive use indemnity. The court set dissolution at the date the separation judgment became final; only residual amounts existing then are considered. Principles: damages require proof of negligent causation; occupancy indemnity requires proof of exclusion from enjoyment; otherwise denied. For indivisible property, sale with equal division was ordered; drawing up final distribution after sale proceeds. Costs reserved. 1.
